label: VERIFIED
extraction: LM Studio vs Ollama (Autonoma): Both ship same two inference engines (Apple MLX and llama.cpp). 5x memory gap is idle overhead, not speed - not token throughput. Real decision: interface, deployment model, disk storage. Ollama installs as single binary with minimal idle overhead. LM Studio includes GUI with higher idle memory. Both have OpenAI-compatible APIs. Ollama better for automation/scripting, LM Studio for interactive use. Measured on identical hardware, token throughput nearly identical.
